```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
round(3.14159, digits=3)

print(seq(1,10,2)) #count numbers from 1 to 10 in 2s

print(rep(2,5))     #prints the number 2 5 times

print(rep(5,7))

x <- 7
print(class(x)) #tells you whetheer x is numeric, character or logical

y <- "nice"

z <- TRUE

print(class(x))
print(class(y))
print(class(z))

cell_ID1 <- "CX1"
cell_ID2 <- "CX2"
treated1 <- TRUE
treated2 <- FALSE
before1 <- 5415
before2 <- 8123
after1 <- 1432
after2 <- 7543

my_first_vector <-c(1,2,3)
print(my_first_vector)

cell1 <- c(cell_ID1, treated1, before1, after1)
cell2 <- c(cell_ID2, treated2, before2, after2)
print(cell1)
print(cell2)3

mdf <- tibble(
  cell_ID= c("CX1", "CX2"),
  Treated= c(TRUE, FALSE),
  Num_cells_before= c(5415, 8123),
  Num_cells_after= c(1432, 7543)
)
 
gt(mdf)
```
